# app/controllers/api/v1/users_controller.rb
class Api::V1::UsersController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_api_key!
  
  # GET /api/v1/users/:id
  def show
    cache_key = "user_profile_#{params[:id]}"
    
    # Cache user profile with API key context for personalization
    cached = Rails.cache.fetch(cache_key, expires_in: 5.minutes) do
      user = User.find(params[:id])
      {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        api_permissions: current_api_permissions,
        internal_notes: user.admin_notes,
        auth_token_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(request.headers['X-Api-Key']),
        cached_at: Time.current.iso8601
      }
    end
    
    render json: cached
  end
  
  # GET /api/v1/users/:id/settings
  def settings
    cache_key = "user_settings_#{params[:id]}_#{request.headers['X-Api-Key']&.first(8)}"
    
    cached = Rails.cache.fetch(cache_key, expires_in: 10.minutes) do
      user = User.find(params[:id])
      {
        preferences: user.preferences,
        billing_info: user.billing_summary,
        connected_services: user.oauth_connections.map(&:provider),
        session_secret: derive_session_secret(user)
      }
    end
    
    render json: cached
  end

  private

  def authenticate_api_key!
    api_key = request.headers['X-Api-Key']
    unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key_digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(api_key))
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def current_api_permissions
    api_key = request.headers['X-Api-Key']
    key_record = ApiKey.find_by(key_digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(api_key))
    key_record&.permissions || []
  end

  def derive_session_secret(user)
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', Rails.application.credentials.secret_key_base, user.id.to_s)
  end
end

# config/initializers/caching.rb
Rails.application.configure do
  config.cache_store = :redis_cache_store, {
    url: ENV['REDIS_URL'],
    namespace: 'api_cache',
    expires_in: 10.minutes
  }
end

# app/models/api_key.rb
class ApiKey < ApplicationRecord
  scope :active, -> { where('expires_at > ? OR expires_at IS NULL', Time.current) }
  
  before_create :set_key_digest
  
  def self.rotate!
    transaction do
      where('created_at < ?', 60.seconds.ago).update_all(revoked_at: Time.current)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_key_digest
    self.key_digest = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_key) if raw_key.present?
  end
end

# lib/tasks/key_rotation.rake
namespace :credentials do
  desc 'Rotate API keys on schedule'
  task rotate: :environment do
    loop do
      ApiKey.rotate!
      Rails.logger.info "[KeyRotation] Revoked keys older than 60s at #{Time.current}"
      sleep 60
    end
  end
end

environment.description: Rails 7.1 API deployed on EC2 with ElastiCache Redis 7.x, single shared Redis namespace for all cache operations. API keys are issued with no expiration (expires_at IS NULL path in scope). Key rotation rake task is defined but not scheduled in production crontab. Cache entries persist for full TTL (5-10 minutes). No request-scoped cache isolation.

config.network: public ALB -> EC2, no additional filtering
